title: Eric Schmidt Reportedly Holds Large Stake in Anthropic
excerpt: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt owns about a 1% stake in AI lab Anthropic, according to recent reports.
body_html:
Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt holds approximately a 1% stake in the artificial intelligence startup Anthropic, according to a recent report by Bloomberg.

This ownership places Schmidt's reported share at roughly half the size of the stake held by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei.

Anthropic has emerged as a leading player in the artificial intelligence sector, drawing significant investments and attention as competition intensifies across the industry.
